title: payment-gateway-adapter
description: A provider-neutral description of what a payment gateway integration supports (issue #94). `provider_id` is an opaque, operator-assigned identifier (e.g. 'primary', 'backup-eu') - this contract never names a specific commercial provider, so the same shape works for any adapter awcms-one selects, and no provider-specific secret or endpoint URL is carried here (credentials are resolved locally by the adapter implementation, never stored in this record).
